title: Profile
intro: Your photo, your details, and how the studio looks and works for you.

blocked.impersonating: Only the person who owns this account can delete it. As an admin you can delete accounts from Admin, under Users.
blocked.reseller: You run a reseller workspace, so your account can't be deleted here. Ask the platform's operator to remove the workspace first.
blocked.onlyOperator: You're the only operator of this platform, so your account can't be deleted.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.badPicture: That file isn't a picture we can open.
profile.photoSaveFailed: Couldn't save the photo. Please try again.
profile.photoRemoveFailed: Couldn't remove the photo. Please try again.
profile.photoHelp: Choose a picture of you (PNG, JPEG or WebP). It's cropped to a square and shown next to your name.
profile.removeHelp: Take your photo off. Your initial shows instead.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHelp: The name shown on your account and in emails we send you.
profile.emailNote: You sign in with this address.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Choose how the studio looks. It's saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.

language.title: Language
language.intro: The language the studio is shown in. It's saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
password.failed: Couldn't change it. Please try again.
password.readOnly: Only the person who owns this account can change its password.
password.newNote: At least 8 characters. Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
password.forgotNote: Don't know your current password (for example, you signed up with Google)? Sign out and use <link>Forgot password</link> to set one.

helpPrefs.title: Help
helpPrefs.saveFailed: Couldn't save that. It will go back the next time you open a page.
helpPrefs.tipsIntro: Short notes that appear when you hold your mouse over a button or setting, explaining what it does in plain words.
helpPrefs.guides: Step-by-step guides for everything are in <link>Help & guides</link>.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.deletesApps: {count, plural, one {Deletes your account and your app, with everything it saved, its files and its web addresses.} other {Deletes your account and all # of your apps, with everything they saved, their files and their web addresses.}}
delete.subscriptionCancelled: Your subscription is cancelled right away.
delete.backupFirst: Download a backup of each app first. You can bring a backup back later with Import.
delete.uploadKeyHelp: Download this key and keep it somewhere safe. Without it, this app can never be updated on Google Play again.
delete.startHelp: Starts deleting your account. You'll be asked to type your email address first; nothing is deleted until you confirm.
delete.keysAck: {count, plural, one {I've downloaded the Google Play upload key above, or I don't need it. Without the key an app can never be updated on Google Play again.} other {I've downloaded the Google Play upload keys above, or I don't need them. Without the key an app can never be updated on Google Play again.}}
delete.typeEmail: Type your email address to confirm
